notes: Measured results from BenchmarkEngine with entryCount=512 and operationCount=50. Measurements include insertion, lookup, deletion latency in milliseconds. RB_TREE shows rotation/recolor instrumentation. HASH/LINEAR show lower overhead. ADAPTIVE migration cost is visible in insert time.
methodology: Same JVM instance, same seed (42), same directory size (512), deterministic workload generation, warmup included, measured with System.nanoTime(), converted to milliseconds. Results represent actual execution, not illustrative estimates.
